verdict.rationale: Several items point to a programmatic control surface: first-party docs describe automating the tailnet via infrastructure-as-code providers and integrations, a community user mentions Tailscale API keys, and another describes a Slack bot updating ACLs on a schedule. However, no item directly documents a public API reference, and the probe found no OpenAPI or Swagger spec at the standard paths. A community report also notes API keys expire after 60 days and need manual renewal, which limits unattended agent use. missing for 10: an explicitly documented public API reference (endpoints, auth model), a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, long-lived or agent-friendly credentials, and hands-on corroboration of agents driving the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
